description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for the Tag entity in the book project, including custom query methods and entity graph configurations.

classes.name: TagRepository
classes.description: Spring Data JPA repository interface for Tag entity with custom query methods.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds a Tag entity by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Tag entity by its primary key with associated books eagerly fetched.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Tag entities with associated books eagerly fetched.
